lines.t: But what we gonna do when the night is past?
Yeah, the church is a man, take his name in vain
With all they saying, dude, just to cover up the stain
They wanna pretense, worship a formatted design
While they're seated in the darkness of their own mind
They're resting on their laurels, highly esteeming their wealth
But only those who know they sick ever seek out health
You trying to box the spirit in a corporate view
But I'm talking about a voice that can make you new
We looking through the stained glass
Trying to see the light
Walking through the valley, yeah, we fighting for our lives
They ask me where I go
To which church do you belong?
I tell them I don't fit in the place where I was born
I belong to no church that is named after me
I walk with y'all, whoo, whoo, whoo
Let the healing begin
Yeah, we peering through the glass, but the vision is blurred
Just an outline of color, we misread the word
Those on the inside looking out remain blind
Holding hands against the brightness that they left behind
They prefer the light future than the brilliance max
But what are people gonna do when the night has passed
And the darkness is thick and the wickedness flows
And the hand of protection finally lets me go
I ain't talking about a suit, I ain't talking about a pew
I'm talking about the faithful and the chosen few
The penance and hearts where the spirit wells up
Like a rubble made inside a broken cup
When they ask you the question, look them right in the eyes
Don't offer them the structure, don't offer them the lies
Tell them I'm not alone
To the Lord, the Messiah, the Christ
And together with the ones who feel the heat to his voice
And remain in his love
That's the church, yeah, where we dwell
We be looking through the stained glass
Try to see the light
Walking through the valley, yeah, we fighting for our life
They ask me where I go
To which church do you belong?
I tell them I don't fit in the place where I was born
I belong to no church that is named of men
I walk with Yahushua, let the healing begin
Shining ever brighter
Even amidst the thick clouds and the darkness
I'll be his voice.
What you gonna do when the night falls?
